content: For pregnant patients diagnosed with diabetes, especially those undergoing insulin therapy, the use of real-time continuous glucose monitoring (rtCGM) has demonstrated substantial advantages. Clinical studies have shown that rtCGM usage leads to improved Time in Range (TIR) metrics and better hemoglobin A1C levels, both of which are crucial for minimizing the risk of complications during pregnancy. However, certain reports have highlighted an associated increase in episodes of hypoglycemia when using rtCGM.
